I did it:

add this to UI.r - these also change the progress bar to red thicker one.

  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
   .shiny-progress .bar {
    background-color: #FF0000;
      .opacity = 1;
  }
 .shiny-progress .progress {
    height:10px;
  }
                   
  .shiny-progress .progress-text .progress-message      
                    {
                    padding: 0px 0px;
                    padding-top: 0px;
                    padding-right: 0px;
                    padding-bottom: 0px;
                    padding-left: 0px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                    font-size: 0%;
                    opacity: 0;
                    }


.shiny-progress .progress-text {
                    position: absolute;
                    right: 10px;
                    height: 24px;
                    width: 240px;
                    background-color: #eef8ff;
                    margin: 0px;
                    padding: 2px 3px;
                    opacity: 0.0;
                   
                    "))
  ),
